notes: The Astro careers page embeds every open role in its JobListingSection island (2 jobs at check time) and renders two selects - Department (All departments + 9) and Location (All locations + Bengaluru, Delhi) - plus a 'Search roles...' input. The component reads q / department / location from /careers?... into initialQ / initialDepartment / initialLocation and filters the embedded list in the browser; the server returns the full list, so filtering is local. Cards link to Ashby apply pages on the company-scoped sarvam board.
